tools.name: formspree_list_submissions
tools.description: List the form's submissions (not spam), newest first by default. Each has its _date and one value per form field. Submissions hold visitors' personal data: ask for the columns you need. Filter by date with since; page with limit and offset. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions.

tools.name: formspree_list_spam_submissions
tools.description: List the submissions Formspree flagged or the owner marked as spam, newest first by default. Use it to check for false positives. Same filters and paging as formspree_list_submissions. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions?spam=true.

tools.name: formspree_get_form_fields
tools.description: The field names (columns) of the form's submissions, taken from the latest 100 submissions. Returns names only, no submission data. Use it to pick the columns for formspree_list_submissions. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions?limit=100.
